Daily life|Advanced.translation: The noise from the street keeps me awake all the time.

Daily life|Advanced.example: Cada quehacer de la casa está repartido entre nosotros.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a task or chore that has to be done
Daily life|Advanced.translation: Every household chore is shared out among us.

Daily life|Advanced.example: ¿Me puedes echar una mano con la mudanza el sábado?
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: to help someone with something
Daily life|Advanced.translation: Can you give me a hand with the move on Saturday?

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mi casa está cerca del parque.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My house is near the park.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Bebo mucha agua durante el día.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I drink a lot of water during the day.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Compro pan fresco todas las mañanas.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a baked food made from flour
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I buy fresh bread every morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Hay leche fría en el refrigerador.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a white drink that comes from cows
Daily life|Beginner.translation: There is cold milk in the fridge.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mi madre cocina muy bien.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My mother cooks very well.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mi padre trabaja en una oficina.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My father works in an office.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mi hermano tiene diez años.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a male brother in a family
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My brother is ten years old.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La comida de hoy está deliciosa.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: food, or a meal you eat
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Today's food is delicious.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La cocina de mi casa es pequeña.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The kitchen in my house is small.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Voy a la cama a las once.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I go to bed at eleven.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Guardo la ropa en el armario.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I keep my clothes in the wardrobe.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La tienda abre a las nueve.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a place where you buy things
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The shop opens at nine.

Daily life|Beginner.example: No tengo dinero en efectivo hoy.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the coins and notes used to buy things
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I don't have any cash today.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Hace mucho frío esta mañana.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: It is very cold this morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: En agosto hace mucho calor aquí.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: It gets very hot here in August.

Daily life|Beginner.example: La lluvia empezó por la tarde.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: water that falls from the clouds
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The rain started in the afternoon.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Estoy muy feliz con mi trabajo nuevo.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am very happy with my new job.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Estoy cansado después del trabajo.
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am tired after work.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Mañana tengo cita con el médico.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a person who treats sick people
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Tomorrow I have an appointment with the doctor.

Daily life|Beginner.example: Voy al mercado los sábados por la mañana.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a place where food and goods are sold
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I go to the market on Saturday mornings.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: En mi barrio hay una panadería excelente.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the part of a town where you live
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: There is an excellent bakery in my neighborhood.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: El alquiler del piso subió este año.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the money you pay each month for a home
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The rent on the flat went up this year.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Todavía no he pagado la factura de la luz.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a paper that says how much you must pay
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I still haven't paid the electricity bill.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Mi abuela me dio la receta del flan.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: instructions for cooking a dish
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: My grandmother gave me the recipe for flan.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: La despensa está casi vacía otra vez.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a cupboard or small room for storing food
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The pantry is almost empty again.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: El único electrodoméstico que uso a diario es la cafetera.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: an electric machine used in the home
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The only appliance I use every day is the coffee maker.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: No me gusta madrugar los fines de semana.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: to get up very early in the morning
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I don't like getting up early on weekends.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Mi horario de trabajo cambia cada semana.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the set times when things happen
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: My work schedule changes every week.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Lavar los platos es la tarea doméstica que más odio.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a job that has to be done around the house
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Washing the dishes is the household chore I hate most.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Este mes tengo un presupuesto muy ajustado.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a plan for how much money you can spend
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: This month I am on a very tight budget.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Me hicieron un descuento del veinte por ciento.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: money taken off the normal price
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: They gave me a twenty percent discount.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: El yogur va a caducar el viernes.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: to go past the date when food is still good
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The yogurt expires on Friday.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Tengo un resfriado desde el lunes.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a mild illness with a runny nose and cough
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I have had a cold since Monday.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Tómate una pastilla si te duele la cabeza.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a small round piece of medicine
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Take a pill if your head hurts.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Llegué a casa agotado después del turno.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: extremely tired
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I got home exhausted after my shift.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: El cielo está despejado y se ven las estrellas.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: clear, with no clouds in the sky
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The sky is clear and you can see the stars.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Hoy está nublado, así que llevaré chaqueta.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: covered with clouds
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: It's cloudy today, so I'll take a jacket.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: No sé qué parentesco tiene ella con mi tío.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the family connection between two people
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I don't know how she is related to my uncle.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: La convivencia con mis compañeros de piso es tranquila.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: living together with other people
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Living with my flatmates is easygoing.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: Mi rutina de la mañana empieza con un café.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the same things you do regularly
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: My morning routine starts with a coffee.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El informe registra un incremento notable del gasto público.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal word for a rise in amount
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The report records a notable increase in public spending.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Se aprecia una disminución constante de la natalidad.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal word for a reduction
IELTS|Advanced.translation: A steady decrease in the birth rate can be seen.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El descenso fue paulatino a lo largo de toda la década.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: happening slowly, step by step
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The decline was gradual throughout the whole decade.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El contraste más acusado aparece entre las dos ciudades.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: very sharp or strongly marked
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The sharpest contrast appears between the two cities.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El crecimiento sostenido del sector sorprendió a los analistas.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: kept up steadily over a long time
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The sustained growth of the sector surprised the analysts.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Los precios podrían repuntar en los próximos meses.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to rise again after going down
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Prices could pick up again in the coming months.

IELTS|Advanced.example: La economía parece estancarse tras una década de crecimiento.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to stop growing or making progress
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The economy seems to be stagnating after a decade of growth.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Entre estos datos cabe destacar el papel de las mujeres jóvenes.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a phrase meaning it is worth highlighting
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Among these figures, the role of young women is worth highlighting.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Los resultados son buenos; no obstante, conviene ser prudente.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal phrase meaning nevertheless
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The results are good; nevertheless, it is wise to be cautious.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El estudio analiza el empleo y, asimismo, el acceso a la vivienda.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal word meaning likewise
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The study looks at employment and, likewise, at access to housing.

IELTS|Advanced.example: La inversión se retrasó y, por consiguiente, la obra sigue parada.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal phrase meaning consequently
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The investment was delayed and, consequently, the building work is still on hold.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El ahorro se logró en detrimento de la calidad del servicio.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a phrase meaning at the expense of
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The savings were achieved at the expense of the quality of the service.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El repunte del consumo es un indicio claro de recuperación.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a sign that something is happening
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The upturn in spending is a clear sign of recovery.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Los resultados tienen un margen de error del tres por ciento.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: how far a result may be off
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The results have a margin of error of three percent.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Habría que matizar esa conclusión con datos más recientes.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: to soften a statement by adding detail
IELTS|Advanced.translation: That conclusion would need to be qualified with more recent data.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El argumento del autor no me parece nada contundente.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: strong and hard to argue against
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The author's argument does not strike me as convincing at all.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El gasto sanitario del país es equiparable al de sus vecinos.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: on the same level as something else
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The country's health spending is comparable to that of its neighbours.

IELTS|Advanced.example: Estoy de acuerdo con su tesis, con una salvedad importante.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: one point you do not fully accept
IELTS|Advanced.translation: I agree with his argument, with one important reservation.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El consumo bajará, presumiblemente, hasta finales de año.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a formal word meaning presumably
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Consumption will presumably fall until the end of the year.

IELTS|Advanced.example: El coste era altísimo; de ahí que el plan se abandonara.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a phrase meaning which is why
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The cost was extremely high, which is why the plan was dropped.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Los precios van a subir otra vez el próximo año.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to go up or rise
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Prices are going to go up again next year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El número de turistas empezó a bajar en octubre.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to go down or fall
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The number of tourists started to fall in October.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El gobierno quiere aumentar el número de autobuses.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to make something bigger in number or size
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The government wants to increase the number of buses.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Este año hay más turistas que el año pasado.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a larger amount or number
IELTS|Beginner.translation: This year there are more tourists than last year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: En invierno viene menos gente a la playa.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a smaller amount or number
IELTS|Beginner.translation: In winter fewer people come to the beach.

IELTS|Beginner.example: La mayor parte de los estudiantes prefiere estudiar en casa.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: bigger or greater than the rest
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Most of the students prefer to study at home.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El número de coches ha crecido mucho en mi ciudad.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: how many there are of something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The number of cars has grown a lot in my city.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El gráfico muestra el consumo de agua en tres países.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a drawing that shows figures
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The chart shows water consumption in three countries.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El porcentaje de mujeres en la empresa es del cuarenta por ciento.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a share counted out of one hundred
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The percentage of women in the company is forty percent.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Hay muchas opciones sanas, por ejemplo la fruta y la verdura.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a phrase used to introduce an example
IELTS|Beginner.translation: There are many healthy options, for example fruit and vegetables.

IELTS|Beginner.example: La razón principal es el precio de la gasolina.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the cause or explanation for something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The main reason is the price of petrol.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Los coches eléctricos son, en mi opinión, la mejor solución.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a phrase used to give your own view
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Electric cars are, in my opinion, the best solution.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El cambio de horario afecta a mucha gente.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: something becoming different
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The change of timetable affects a lot of people.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El tráfico es un problema serio en las grandes ciudades.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a difficulty that needs solving
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Traffic is a serious problem in big cities.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El total de visitantes fue de dos millones el año pasado.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the full amount added together
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The total number of visitors was two million last year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Es útil comparar los dos gráficos antes de escribir.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to look at two things side by side
IELTS|Beginner.translation: It is useful to compare the two charts before writing.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El informe también habla del uso del agua.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: as well or in addition
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The report also talks about water use.

IELTS|Beginner.example: El precio bajó en enero, pero volvió a subir en marzo.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a word joining two contrasting ideas
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The price fell in January, but it went up again in March.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Mucha gente usa el tren porque es más barato que el coche.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a word that gives the reason for something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Many people use the train because it is cheaper than the car.

IELTS|Beginner.example: Yo creo que el gobierno debería hacer más por el medio ambiente.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a phrase for saying what you think
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I think the government should do more for the environment.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El gráfico muestra una tendencia clara al alza.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the general direction of a change
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The chart shows a clear upward trend.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El crecimiento del turismo ha sido muy rápido en la costa.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: an increase in size or amount over time
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The growth of tourism has been very fast on the coast.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Se observa un descenso en el número de nacimientos.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a fall in a number or level
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: A decline can be seen in the number of births.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Hubo un aumento del diez por ciento en las ventas de coches.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a rise in a number or level
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: There was a ten percent increase in car sales.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Las ventas subieron en Francia, mientras que en Italia bajaron.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase used to contrast two facts
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Sales rose in France, whereas in Italy they fell.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El norte creció mucho; el sur, en cambio, se quedó igual.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase meaning on the other hand
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The north grew a lot; the south, on the other hand, stayed the same.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Los datos son claros; sin embargo, conviene leer la letra pequeña.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase meaning however
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The figures are clear; however, it is worth reading the small print.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El transporte es caro y, además, poco puntual.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: on top of that
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Transport is expensive and, on top of that, not very punctual.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La demanda cayó y, por lo tanto, los precios también bajaron.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase meaning therefore
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Demand fell and, therefore, prices came down as well.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El proyecto salió adelante a pesar de las críticas.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase meaning in spite of
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The project went ahead in spite of the criticism.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La principal ventaja del tren es que puedes trabajar durante el viaje.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a good point or benefit
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The main advantage of the train is that you can work during the journey.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La mayor desventaja de vivir en el centro es el ruido.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a bad point or drawback
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The biggest disadvantage of living in the centre is the noise.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Los datos del informe son del año pasado.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: facts and figures used as evidence
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The data in the report is from last year.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La cifra más alta corresponde al mes de julio.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a particular number in a set of results
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The highest figure belongs to the month of July.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: La media de horas de estudio es de tres al día.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the usual value found by averaging
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The average number of study hours is three a day.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El consumo de agua se mantuvo estable durante todo el verano.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: staying at the same level
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Water consumption stayed steady throughout the summer.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: El número de usuarios se va a duplicar en cinco años.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: to become twice as much
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The number of users is going to double in five years.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Desde mi punto de vista, hay que invertir más en educación.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the way one person sees a matter
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: From my point of view, we need to invest more in education.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Los precios probablemente seguirán subiendo este año.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: most likely
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Prices will probably keep rising this year.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: Los tres países, en resumen, siguen caminos muy distintos.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: a phrase used to sum up
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The three countries, in short, are following very different paths.

Travel|Advanced.example: Decidimos pernoctar en un pueblo de montaña antes de seguir.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to spend the night in a place
Travel|Advanced.translation: We decided to spend the night in a mountain village before carrying on.

Travel|Advanced.example: Suele hospedarse siempre en el mismo hotel del centro.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to stay somewhere as a guest
Travel|Advanced.translation: He always stays at the same hotel downtown.

Travel|Advanced.example: Para llegar al aeropuerto hay que hacer transbordo en la última parada.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a change from one vehicle or line to another
Travel|Advanced.translation: To get to the airport you have to change lines at the last stop.

Travel|Advanced.example: La sala de tránsito estaba llena de pasajeros dormidos.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: passing through a place on the way elsewhere
Travel|Advanced.translation: The transit lounge was full of sleeping passengers.

Travel|Advanced.example: Dejamos las mochilas en la consigna de la estación.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a place where you leave bags for a while
Travel|Advanced.translation: We left our backpacks in the luggage storage at the station.

Travel|Advanced.example: Por culpa de la sobreventa nos dejaron en tierra.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: selling more seats than actually exist
Travel|Advanced.translation: Because of the overbooking, we got bumped from the flight.

Travel|Advanced.example: Todavía arrastro el desfase horario del vuelo a Tokio.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: tiredness after crossing several time zones
Travel|Advanced.translation: I'm still shaking off the jet lag from the flight to Tokyo.

Travel|Advanced.example: La aerolínea me compensó por el extravío del equipaje.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the loss of something that goes missing
Travel|Advanced.translation: The airline compensated me for losing my luggage.

Travel|Advanced.example: Reclamé el reembolso del billete que cancelaron.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: money paid back to you
Travel|Advanced.translation: I claimed a refund for the ticket they cancelled.

Travel|Advanced.example: Pedí la hoja de reclamaciones porque la habitación estaba sucia.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an official form for making a complaint
Travel|Advanced.translation: I asked for the complaints form because the room was dirty.

Travel|Advanced.example: Puse una denuncia en comisaría después del robo.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an official report of a crime to the police
Travel|Advanced.translation: I filed a police report after the robbery.

Travel|Advanced.example: Necesitas un visado para quedarte más de tres meses.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: official permission to enter a country
Travel|Advanced.translation: You need a visa to stay longer than three months.

Travel|Advanced.example: El trámite del permiso se puede hacer por internet.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an official step or piece of paperwork
Travel|Advanced.translation: The permit paperwork can be done online.

Travel|Advanced.example: En ese mercado es normal regatear el precio.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to bargain in order to lower a price
Travel|Advanced.translation: In that market it's normal to haggle over the price.

Travel|Advanced.example: Desde el mirador se ve toda la bahía.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a high spot with a wide view
Travel|Advanced.translation: From the lookout you can see the whole bay.

Travel|Advanced.example: Nos perdimos paseando por el casco antiguo de Toledo.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the oldest central part of a city
Travel|Advanced.translation: We got lost wandering around the old town of Toledo.

Travel|Advanced.example: El turismo de masas ha encarecido todo el barrio.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: travel by very large crowds of tourists
Travel|Advanced.translation: Mass tourism has made the whole neighborhood expensive.

Travel|Advanced.example: Nos vamos de escapada a la sierra este fin de semana.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a short trip away for a break
Travel|Advanced.translation: We're off on a getaway to the mountains this weekend.

Travel|Advanced.example: Mi tío es un trotamundos que nunca para quieto.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a person who travels all over the world
Travel|Advanced.translation: My uncle is a globetrotter who never sits still.

Travel|Advanced.example: Siempre dejo hacer las maletas para el último momento.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: to pack your bags for a trip
Travel|Advanced.translation: I always leave packing my bags until the last minute.

Travel|Beginner.example: El viaje en tren fue muy tranquilo.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a trip from one place to another
Travel|Beginner.translation: The train journey was very peaceful.

Travel|Beginner.example: Me encanta viajar con poco equipaje.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: to go to another place, often far away
Travel|Beginner.translation: I love traveling light.

Travel|Beginner.example: El avión aterriza a las seis de la tarde.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a flying machine that carries passengers
Travel|Beginner.translation: The plane lands at six in the evening.

Travel|Beginner.example: Nuestro vuelo sale desde la terminal dos.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a journey made by plane
Travel|Beginner.translation: Our flight leaves from terminal two.

Travel|Beginner.example: Llegamos al aeropuerto con tres horas de antelación.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the place where planes take off and land
Travel|Beginner.translation: We arrived at the airport three hours early.

Travel|Beginner.example: El hotel está a diez minutos del centro.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a building where travelers pay to sleep
Travel|Beginner.translation: The hotel is ten minutes from the city center.

Travel|Beginner.example: Pedimos una habitación con dos camas.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a room, especially one for sleeping in
Travel|Beginner.translation: We asked for a room with two beds.

Travel|Beginner.example: Mi maleta pesa más de veinte kilos.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a large bag for clothes when you travel
Travel|Beginner.translation: My suitcase weighs more than twenty kilos.

Travel|Beginner.example: Guardo la cámara y el agua en la mochila.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a bag you carry on your back
Travel|Beginner.translation: I keep the camera and the water in my backpack.

Travel|Beginner.example: Compré un billete de ida y vuelta a Roma.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a paper that lets you travel or enter
Travel|Beginner.translation: I bought a round-trip ticket to Rome.

Travel|Beginner.example: Tienes que enseñar el pasaporte en el control.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: an official document for traveling abroad
Travel|Beginner.translation: You have to show your passport at the checkpoint.

Travel|Beginner.example: El tren de las siete va directo a Sevilla.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a long vehicle that runs on rails
Travel|Beginner.translation: The seven o'clock train goes straight to Seville.

Travel|Beginner.example: Te espero en la estación dentro de media hora.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a place where trains or buses stop
Travel|Beginner.translation: I'll wait for you at the station in half an hour.

Travel|Beginner.example: El autobús al centro pasa cada quince minutos.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a big road vehicle that carries many people
Travel|Beginner.translation: The bus to the center comes every fifteen minutes.

Travel|Beginner.example: Cogimos un taxi porque llovía mucho.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a car you pay to take you somewhere
Travel|Beginner.translation: We took a taxi because it was raining hard.

Travel|Beginner.example: Alquilamos un coche pequeño para recorrer la isla.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a car for a few passengers
Travel|Beginner.translation: We rented a small car to drive around the island.

Travel|Beginner.example: Siempre llevo un mapa de papel por si acaso.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a drawing that shows places and roads
Travel|Beginner.translation: I always carry a paper map just in case.

Travel|Beginner.example: La playa está a cinco minutos del hotel.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the sandy land beside the sea
Travel|Beginner.translation: The beach is five minutes from the hotel.

Travel|Beginner.example: El restaurante está en la calle de al lado.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a road in a town with buildings along it
Travel|Beginner.translation: The restaurant is on the next street over.

Travel|Beginner.example: Un turista me preguntó cómo llegar al museo.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: someone visiting a place for pleasure
Travel|Beginner.translation: A tourist asked me how to get to the museum.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Facturamos el equipaje y subimos a la sala de espera.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: all the bags you take on a trip
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We checked our luggage and went up to the waiting area.

Travel|Intermediate.example: La puerta de embarque cambió a última hora.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the act of getting on a plane or ship
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The boarding gate changed at the last minute.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Prefiero no facturar y llevar solo una bolsa de mano.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to hand in your bags before a flight
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I'd rather not check any bags and just take a carry-on.

Travel|Intermediate.example: El vuelo hace una escala de dos horas en Lisboa.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a short stop on the way to somewhere
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The flight has a two-hour stopover in Lisbon.

Travel|Intermediate.example: El tren lleva media hora de retraso.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the state of running later than planned
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The train is running half an hour late.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Hice la reserva del hotel por internet.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a place held for you in advance
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I made the hotel booking online.

Travel|Intermediate.example: El precio incluye el alojamiento y el desayuno.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a place where you stay and sleep
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The price includes accommodation and breakfast.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Es más barato alojarse en un hostal que en un hotel.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to stay somewhere for a while
Travel|Intermediate.translation: It's cheaper to stay in a guesthouse than in a hotel.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Pasamos la aduana sin que nos revisaran nada.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the border office that checks what you bring
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We went through customs without anyone checking a thing.

Travel|Intermediate.example: El tren a Valencia sale del andén número cuatro.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the raised area beside the train tracks
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The train to Valencia leaves from platform number four.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Deja la llave en recepción antes de marcharte.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the front desk of a hotel
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Leave the key at reception before you head off.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Pregunta en el mostrador de información del aeropuerto.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a long counter where staff attend to people
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Ask at the information desk in the airport.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Queremos alquilar un coche durante toda la semana.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: to pay to use something for a time
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We want to rent a car for the whole week.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Cambiamos el itinerario por culpa de la lluvia.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the planned route and stops of a trip
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We changed the itinerary because of the rain.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Nuestro siguiente destino es la costa portuguesa.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the place you are traveling to
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Our next destination is the Portuguese coast.

Travel|Intermediate.example: El trayecto en autobús dura unas cinco horas.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the ride between two points
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The bus ride takes about five hours.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Hicimos una excursión de un día a las montañas.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a short trip taken for pleasure
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We took a day trip to the mountains.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Dormimos en un albergue limpio y muy barato.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: cheap shared lodging for travelers
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We slept in a clean and very cheap hostel.

Travel|Intermediate.example: Reservamos media pensión para no preocuparnos por la cena.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a hotel rate with breakfast and one main meal
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We booked half board so we wouldn't have to worry about dinner.

Travel|Intermediate.example: En temporada alta los hoteles se llenan enseguida.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the busiest time of year for travel
Travel|Intermediate.translation: In high season the hotels fill up right away.
